# StayOS

> The operating system for hotel General Managers and associates — a
> mobile-first platform turning fragmented hotel operational data into
> proactive, AI-generated intelligence.

- Prototype/demo monorepo (not production).
- Each feature is a self-contained top-level directory with its own backend,
  frontend, infrastructure, docs, and `README.md`. Follow the root
  [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for repository guidance. This single repo-root
  `llms.txt` is the one index for the whole repo — features do not carry their own.
- Features share one PWA origin, one Cognito user pool, one AWS WAF web ACL, and
  one DynamoDB operational data layer. Three static-export Next.js apps are
  served from ONE shared CloudFront distribution: the StayOS shell at `/`
  (unified login + feature launcher), LUMI at `/lumi`, PULSE at `/pulse`. A GM
  signs in once at the shell and both features trust the shared browser session
  (single sign-on). Serverless-first, CloudFormation nested stacks, Python 3.12
  + Next.js, `us-east-1`.

## Apps

- [StayOS shell](stayos-shell/README.md): unified login + feature launcher at
  `/`. Login when unauthenticated, feature grid (LUMI, PULSE) when authenticated.
  Static-export Next.js; consumes the shared `@stayos/auth` module.
- [LUMI](lumi/README.md): Feature 1, built and deployed. Served at `/lumi`. Daily
  AI-generated GM brief (KPIs, VIP arrivals, overbooking risk, OOO rooms) as a
  dashboard + audio brief, plus voice/chat Q&A agents. Voice uses the GA Strands
  `BidiAgent` with Nova Sonic 2.5 (`amazon.nova-2-5-sonic`).
- [PULSE](pulse/README.md): Feature 2, built and tested. Served at `/pulse`.
  Real-time tiered (CRITICAL/WARNING/INFO) AI-triaged alerts with closed-loop
  resolution: a DynamoDB Streams rule engine, agentic triage on Amazon Bedrock
  AgentCore Runtime via the shared StayOS Gateway, and dual-channel delivery
  (AppSync Events realtime + Web Push). A second, additive **Forecasting Agent**
  runs ahead of the rule engine on a per-property daily schedule to predict room
  oversell (advisory `FORECAST_OVERSELL` alerts; human-in-the-loop, never
  auto-executed). Deploys with the whole platform via `make deploy-all`.

## LUMI voice

- [nova_sonic_session.py](lumi/backend/services/voice-agent/nova_sonic_session.py):
  adapts GA Strands `BidiAgent` and `BedrockNovaSonicModel` to the existing
  browser WebSocket protocol. Strands manages streaming, tool execution,
  transcript assembly, and conversation history across connection renewals.
  Preserves `tiffany`, 16 kHz input PCM, and 24 kHz output PCM.
- [server.py](lumi/backend/services/voice-agent/server.py):
  AgentCore WebSocket entrypoint. The browser connects with SigV4 credentials
  from a Cognito Identity Pool; the backend verifies the access token with
  Cognito and binds tools to the authenticated GM's property.
- [useVoiceAgent.ts](lumi/frontend/src/hooks/useVoiceAgent.ts):
  browser capture and playback. Waits for `sessionStarted` before sending
  microphone audio and clears queued playback on interruption.
- [requirements.txt](lumi/backend/services/voice-agent/requirements.txt):
  authoritative GA Strands and transport SDK pins for the voice container.
- [Voice upgrade procedure](docs/deployment-pipeline.md#focused-voice-upgrade):
  `make lumi-voice-upgrade` builds only the existing voice image, reviews scoped
  CloudFormation changes, and updates the runtime with a pinned image digest.
  `make lumi-voice-rollback` restores the saved policy and image;
  `make lumi-voice-description` applies only description metadata.
  Use explicit `PROFILE`, `CLOUDFORMATION_PROFILE`, `REGION`, and
  `EXPECTED_ACCOUNT_ID`. Frontend publication is separate: regenerate live
  configuration before building and publishing. Runtime readiness alone does
  not prove voice recognition, conversation context, or interruption works.

## Operational data semantics

- Brief generation runs with `MOCK_MODE=false` and reads the same
  property/day revenue records as chat and voice tools. The pure
  [revenue_kpis.py](lumi/backend/functions/orchestrator/revenue_kpis.py)
  formatter is packaged with the orchestrator and historical seeder so
  fractional occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR are preserved in both.
- Historical seeding reads stored revenues and skips dates without a source.
  Existing briefs are not overwritten by seeding; deployed cached briefs and
  audio require regeneration when publishing this correction.
- Occupancy tool `totalRooms` is total inventory capacity. The dataset and
  PULSE REST responses retain legacy `availableRooms` capacity fields.
  Neither represents vacant or remaining sellable rooms; agents must not
  infer that availability from occupancy or maintenance counts.
- Kitchen daily Orders includes completed orders. The In-flight summary
  matches the active `kitchenOrders` array, normalized when snapshots are
  built and read; no reseed is needed for legacy counts.

## Shared

- [shared/README.md](shared/README.md): the cross-feature shared layer.
- [shared/auth/src/index.ts](shared/auth/src/index.ts): `@stayos/auth` — the
  single client-side auth module shared by the shell, LUMI, and PULSE (Cognito
  sign-in/refresh and JWT decode). Consumed via a build-time TypeScript path alias.
- [shared/auth/src/storage.ts](shared/auth/src/storage.ts): shared `stayos.*`
  token storage. Fresh installs use `localStorage`; an existing legacy
  `sessionStorage` login remains authoritative for the current document so a
  feature can be upgraded independently of the shell. Tokens from different
  stores are never combined, and explicit sign-out clears both stores.
- [shared/data-orchestrator/infrastructure/data-orchestrator.yaml](shared/data-orchestrator/infrastructure/data-orchestrator.yaml):
  the Unified Data Orchestrator nested stack (`StackPrefix` `stayos-data`) — the
  `stayos-data-orchestrator` Step Functions state machine
  (Quiesce -> Generate -> Reconcile -> UnQuiesce -> RegenerateBrief -> PrimeBaseline)
  plus one per-property EventBridge Scheduler rule that rolls the demo dataset
  forward at each property's local midnight.
- [shared/data-orchestrator/handlers/generate_handler.py](shared/data-orchestrator/handlers/generate_handler.py):
  the Generate step Lambda — re-anchors the deterministic 30-day window to a new
  `Reference_Date` and idempotently upserts it (reuses the LUMI generators; never
  bulk-deletes on the scheduled path).
- [shared/data-orchestrator/handlers/prime_baseline_handler.py](shared/data-orchestrator/handlers/prime_baseline_handler.py):
  the PrimeBaseline step Lambda — invokes the PULSE baseline builder after
  un-quiesce to seed the ambient curated PULSE feed.

## Shared data seams (PULSE-owned, orchestrator-consumed)

- [pulse/backend/src/pulse/baseline/builder.py](pulse/backend/src/pulse/baseline/builder.py):
  the curated PULSE baseline builder — deterministic, bounded reset-then-prime of
  `pulse-alerts` items (`baselineManaged = True`, `baseline#` dedupe prefix) so a
  presenter opens PULSE to a predictable ambient feed.
- [pulse/backend/src/pulse/rule_engine/quiesce.py](pulse/backend/src/pulse/rule_engine/quiesce.py):
  the PULSE quiesce seam — bounded, reversible suppression of rule-engine stream
  consumption during the bulk roll-forward, called by the orchestrator's
  Quiesce/UnQuiesce steps.
- [pulse/backend/src/pulse/demo_simulator/simulator.py](pulse/backend/src/pulse/demo_simulator/simulator.py):
  the demo scenario simulator behind the presenter live-fire routes
  (`POST /demo/scenarios/{scenarioId}` + `/reset`, gated by `EnableDemoSimulator`)
  — deterministic scenario catalog, variant-scoped runs, and reset.

## PULSE Forecasting Agent (predictive, advisory)

- [pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/app.py](pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/app.py):
  the thin Strands entrypoint — binds one `propertyId`, orchestrates
  read_signals -> run_forecast -> author_remediation_plan -> reconcile_alerts,
  and performs no write-back of its own.
- [pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/engine.py](pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/engine.py):
  the PURE, deterministic Forecast Engine (no I/O, no clients, no model) — owns
  the horizon, oversell classification, rooms-oversold, and integer 0-100
  confidence. The determinism boundary: every number comes from here.
- [pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/narrative.py](pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/narrative.py):
  the Remediation Plan Author — Claude Sonnet authors only the narrative/steps
  around the engine's fixed numbers (Bedrock Converse), with a deterministic
  template fallback when no model is configured or it errors.
- [pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/alerts.py](pulse/backend/services/forecast-agent/forecast/alerts.py):
  the Alert Writer — `dedupeKey` (`forecast#{propertyId}#OVERSELL#{day}`),
  threshold gate, severity mapping, create-vs-update-in-place, resolve-when-no-
  longer-forecast, and best-effort realtime/Web Push delivery.
- [pulse/backend/functions/forecast-invoker/lambda_function.py](pulse/backend/functions/forecast-invoker/lambda_function.py):
  the thin EventBridge Scheduler target that starts a `pulse-forecaster`
  AgentCore Runtime session for a given `propertyId`.

## Docs

- [docs/data-model.md](docs/data-model.md): canonical platform-wide DynamoDB
  data-model reference (LUMI + PULSE tables, keys/GSIs, volumes) plus the
  Unified Data Orchestrator note — how the demo data is seeded, rolled forward,
  quiesced, baselined, and fired live on stage.
- [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml): Unified StayOS REST API specification and
  authoritative contract for both LUMI and PULSE.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): root contributor/agent guide — repo-wide safety,
  conventions, and per-feature workflow.
- [docs/deployment-pipeline.md](docs/deployment-pipeline.md): account-aware
  deployment, frontend configuration, focused voice upgrades, and recovery.

  populated `shared/auth/` module and why the infrastructure carve-out is still
